Rawat's remarkable contributions in both Hindi and South Indian cinema were matched only by his genuine humility and strong on-screen presence. He leaves behind a lasting legacy.

description: Six-year-old Asher Harvey, who was born with a complex heart condition and has undergone multiple heart surgeries, fulfilled his dream of becoming a Carolina Panthers player for a day through Make-A-Wish. He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
description: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: 'It's my fault': Stokes blames himself for McCullum's England Test coach exit
description: Former England captain Ben Stokes desires to coach the national team in the future. He is currently pursuing his Level Three coaching qualification while still playing. Stokes confirmed his international playing career has concluded, dismissing Ashes return speculation. He expressed surprise at Joe Root's appointment as Test captain over Harry Brook. Stokes praised Stephen Fleming as the new Test coach and wished Root success.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
description: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: American investor Michael Burry, who warned of 2008 crisis, sees a 'bloody mess'
description: Michael Burry warns of market carnage from automated trading funds.  He sees rapid unwinds potentially unleashing significant market disruption.  Volatility levels are climbing to their highest in nearly a century.  Burry also criticizes large AI deals and their funding structures.  These complex arrangements could expose investors to substantial future risks.

title: Spain imported US crayfish in 1974, 50 years later they cannot be removed
description: Fifty years ago, American red crayfish were introduced to Spain's Guadalquivir River basin, and they have since established a permanent presence. These aggressive invaders have wreaked havoc on local wildlife and disrupted aquatic ecosystems. Yet, local communities have successfully built an economy around their harvesting and processing. This dependence has sparked legal disputes, resulting in a compromise that permits regulated harvesting, balancing ecological health with economic viability.

title: Meet Roy Kim, 13, who turns air moisture into water for farms
description: In a remarkable feat of ingenuity, a young student has created technology that converts air moisture into potable water. This device stands as a sustainable beacon for farmers struggling with inadequate water supply. Featuring a Peltier module for condensation, it smartly monitors water delivery and environmental factors through advanced sensors. Roy Kim aspires for his invention to play a significant role in alleviating the global water challenges faced by agriculture.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey from poverty to football greatness
description: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.
